definitions.explanation: Used for singing songs, whether casually, in karaoke, or professionally.

examples.japanese: カラオケで{歌|うた}いました。
{日本語|にほんご}の{歌|うた}を{歌|うた}いたいです。
examples.english: I want to sing a Japanese song.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{上手|じょうず}に{歌|うた}います。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xを{歌|うた}う (sing X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {歌|うた}っている = 'is singing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{歌|うた}を{歌|うた}う (sing a song)
・カラオケで{歌|うた}う (sing at karaoke)
・{上手|じょうず}に{歌|うた}う (sing well)
・{歌|うた}い{方|かた} (way of singing)

In Japan, karaoke is a popular pastime, so this verb is commonly used.
